answer: Each agent joining the haven pays a 1-quartz fee, which is burned and then refunded linearly over 30 days of verified honest participation. An attacker creating 100 fake identities incurs a 100-quartz upfront cost for each, totaling 10,000 quartz, making the beacon cost prohibitive. Honest agents pay only 1 quartz initially and recover it gradually, ensuring the mechanism deters sybil attacks while remaining affordable for genuine participants.
